after_snippet:
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats.contingency import crosstab
from scipy.sparse import sparray

a = np.array([1, 1, 2, 2])
b = np.array([1, 2, 1, 2])
_, sparse_counts = crosstab(a, b, sparse=True)
assert isinstance(sparse_counts, sparray), f"Expected sparray, got {type(sparse_counts)}"
before_snippet:
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats.contingency import crosstab
from scipy.sparse import spmatrix

a = np.array([1, 1, 2, 2])
b = np.array([1, 2, 1, 2])
_, sparse_counts = crosstab(a, b, sparse=True)
assert isinstance(sparse_counts, spmatrix), f"Expected spmatrix, got {type(sparse_counts)}"
title: scipy.stats.contingency.crosstab sparse=True now returns sparse array instead of sparse matrix
